freeze_assertion: This preregistration (hypotheses, targets, features, blocks, baselines, materiality floor, decision gates, source hashes, config hash) was frozen BEFORE any outcome on the downloaded archive data was computed. No holdout outcome, coefficient, or QLIKE value influenced any cutoff, feature, or threshold below.
config_hash: sha256 of this prereg document + source registry + eval script, recorded after freeze in eval manifest
research_question: Do funding extremes + open-interest/taker-flow imbalance improve out-of-sample forecasts of next-24-hour realized variance over a realized-volatility-only baseline, on the previously unexploited Binance public archive (data.binance.vision metrics/fundingRate/markPriceKlines domain)?
primary_hypothesis: H1: Candidate C2 (RV + funding + OI + taker imbalance) achieves a >= 2% relative QLIKE reduction vs baseline B1 (RV-only HAR) on next-24-hour realized variance, averaged across 3 chronological test blocks, with uncertainty supporting improvement.
unit: one eligible linear perpetual contract (BTCUSDT) × one fully closed UTC hourly forecast timestamp t
forecast_timestamp: t is immediately after all data for closed hour t are available; every input available by t; outcomes begin with the next hourly interval (t+1..t+24); no same-bar or future data enters a predictor
data_domain: Binance public archive data.binance.vision (futures/um/daily/metrics, futures/um/monthly/fundingRate, futures/um/monthly/markPriceKlines/1h), unauthenticated, deep history; metrics dataset never previously exploited by the frozen frontier

target.name: next_24h_realized_variance
target.definition: sum of squared 1-hour mark-price log returns over the next 24 complete hourly intervals, from t+1 through t+24
target.horizons_secondary_note: registered secondary horizons; not promoted over primary

features_causal: RV1h, RV24h, RV168h: trailing realized variances from hourly mark-price log returns ending no later than t
signed funding: latest funding observation whose availability timestamp is no later than t (sign retained)
abs funding extremeness: percentile rank of |funding| vs that contract's preceding 90 calendar days only; require >= 30 valid historical funding observations before emitting
sum_open_interest: latest daily value available by t
sum_taker_long_short_vol_ratio: latest daily value available by t
mark/index premium: NOT available in this download (indexPriceKlines not fetched); recorded as missing, never zero-filled
missing_data_rule: Missing features remain missing; never zero-filled or forward-filled to make models comparable. Common eligible rows across compared models.
embargo: 7 calendar days at the train/test boundary; no target interval overlaps training/validation/test folds

models.name: realized-volatility-only HAR
models.form: OLS log(RV+1e-12) ~ log RV1h + log RV24h + log RV168h; train-only standardization; Duan smearing back-transform

models.name: funding+OI+taker candidate
models.form: B1 + signed funding + abs funding percentile + sum_open_interest + sum_taker_long_short_vol_ratio; same fitting procedure

primary_contrast: C2 versus B1 on paired out-of-sample QLIKE (24-hour target)
secondary_contrasts_note: registered secondary contrasts in the same multiplicity family

metric.primary: QLIKE = mean(ratio - 1 - log(ratio)), ratio = y / pred, y>0, pred>0

materiality_floor: >= 2% relative QLIKE reduction (C2 vs B1) required to pass the practical-improvement condition; frozen in advance, not relaxed after outcomes
uncertainty: paired out-of-sample QLIKE difference reported as absolute difference and relative reduction; block-aware uncertainty across the 3 chronological test blocks; leave-one-block-out stability reported
multiplicity: Primary contrast C2 vs B1; secondary contrasts C1 vs B1 and C2 vs C1 declared in the same family; raw and adjusted results disclosed
decision_gate: CONFIRMED requires: (a) paired QLIKE difference supports C2 improvement, (b) relative reduction >= 2% materiality floor, (c) uncertainty interval supports improvement across blocks, (d) no unresolved leakage/source/label/timestamp defect. Otherwise NOT_SUPPORTED or INCONCLUSIVE; null results preserved.
negative_results: Preserved as NOT_SUPPORTED/INCONCLUSIVE with explanation; not relabeled as confirmatory
liquidation_label_rule: No observed liquidation labels exist on this source. Any liquidation-risk statement is a modeled proxy (OI + taker imbalance + mark dislocation), labeled LIQUIDATION_RISK_PROXY, never an observed liquidation.
stdlib_only_note: numpy/pandas/scipy not installed in runner; all computation stdlib
